title: China's nuclear race, 2010 to 2024
description:
In 2010 China was 9th in nuclear power. By 2024 it made 6.0 times as much.
From 75 TWh in 2010 to 451 TWh in 2024, 19% more than France.
Set the cost of money yourself: https://rimilab.com/#/mba/cost-of-capital
Data: Ember and Energy Institute, via Our World in Data (CC BY 4.0).
